niche_statement: Defense and intelligence technology companies in the $5M-$10M range whose proven prototype is stuck between demo and fielded deployment, guided by a CTO who fielded a patented tactical Android app platform with operators in theater and now engineers deployment architecture and acquisition advocacy from day one.
edp: When months-to-field exceeds the funded months remaining on the contract, the program dies in the DoD valley of death - and for a $5M-$10M defense tech company, one dead transition is often the company.
expertise_statements: Transition our prototype from successful demo to fielded operational capability with military end users
Stand up our first real engineering organization as we grow past SBIR-funded prototype work
Build deployment architecture that survives DoD operational environments, not just the lab
Navigate RMF and achieve Authority to Operate (ATO) so our software can run on government networks
Get our company CMMC / NIST 800-171 compliant before it costs us the contract
Develop Android applications for tactical edge users in disconnected, intermittent, low-bandwidth (DDIL) environments
Build ATAK/TAK plugins and integrate position location information (PLI) and geospatial data for dispatched operators
Support field deployments of our system with operators at OCONUS and austere sites
Manage cost, schedule, and technical performance against DoD contract milestones and periods of performance
Transition our SBIR Phase II effort into a Phase III or program-of-record production contract
Integrate our sensor/data-collection product with government back-end data management systems
Run capture and proposal efforts so a small engineering team can win and keep DoD task orders
Serve as our ISSO and own security documentation, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring
Harden and security-audit our platform for ITAR-controlled and classified-adjacent programs
Coordinate with prime contractors as a subcontractor and manage flow-down requirements
Prototype rapidly against operator feedback and compress build-test-field cycles
Apply machine learning / computer vision to mission data collection and monitoring
Lead engineering while the founders focus on BD because nobody senior owns the technical roadmap
jd_lexicon: denied, degraded, intermittent, and limited bandwidth
disqualifiers: large defense primes with established CTO organizations (Lockheed Martin, RTX, Boeing, Northrop Grumman, General Dynamics, L3Harris, BAE)
federal systems integrators and body-shop staffing agencies hiring cleared billets for client sites
pure commercial SaaS with no government or defense customer motion
recruiting agencies posting on behalf of unnamed clients
companies whose only defense tie is reselling or distribution
hardware-only machine shops with no software product
